semiconductor_relevance: High — Linde LienHwa is a major industrial gas manufacturer in Taiwan, providing essential gases and gas-application technologies for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Linde LienHwa (LLH) is a leading supplier of industrial gases in Taiwan, formed as a joint venture between the Mitac Group and Linde plc. The company offers high-quality gas solutions and technologies that are critical for semiconductor fabrication processes.
capabilities: Gas application technologies for etching and deposition

regional_presence.Taiwan: Linde LienHwa is one of the largest industrial gas manufacturers in Taiwan, supporting local semiconductor industries with infrastructure and technology.
